entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语词头疑为 soberbio（倨傲、骄傲），其释义行残损不可通读；汉字“最假色确”义暂难通解
entries.en: defective entry: lemma prob. soberbio 'haughty, arrogant'; the Spanish definition line is fragmentary and the Chinese equivalent 'zui jia se que' remains unresolved
entries.notes: 西语释义行两处[残]且文句不通，汉字四字与闽南转写皆无法与词头互证，故存疑

entries.zh: 强嘴；强辩顶撞（倨傲多言、出言不逊）
entries.en: soberbio hablador: an insolent, overbearing talker; to talk back / argue belligerently

entries.zh: 贿赂；行贿买通（cohecho 即贿赂、买通之财）
entries.en: to bribe; bribery, corrupt payment (cohecho)

entries.zh: 赂；贿赂的财物，行贿送礼
entries.en: a bribe, gift to corrupt; to bribe (cohecho)

entries.zh: 贿赂；以财物买通人
entries.en: bribery; a bribe; to bribe

entries.zh: 买嘱；贿买嘱托（出钱嘱托人办事、作证）
entries.en: to buy off and commission (mai-zhu, bribe someone to do one's bidding); sobornar / comprar

entries.zh: 抹舌〔释义存疑〕；疑指以贿堵口封舌、使人不敢言（与下条‘塞口’相类）
entries.en: 'to wipe/smooth the tongue' (second character doubtful); prob. to gag or silence someone by bribery — uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字第二字（舌/𠯑）与闽南转写皆标[疑]，其与 sobornar 的对应义无法确证，仅据下条‘塞口’类推

entries.zh: 塞口；堵嘴（以财物使人口不能言、噤声）
entries.en: to stop the mouth, gag; to silence (a witness) with money

entries.zh: 贿赂书办、书记（escribano：文书员、公证书记）；汉字‘过带’义待考〔闽南栏残损〕
entries.en: to bribe the escribano (scribe/notary/clerk); the Chinese equivalent 'guo dai' is unresolved
entries.notes: 闽南栏[残]且‘帶/soa’两栏不能互证，释义主要依西语词头 sobornar al escriuano

entries.zh: 过先生；给先生（书办、塾师之尊称，此处即西语 escribano 书记/文书员）送贿
entries.en: to bribe the 'master' (sin-seng, honorific here for the escribano/scribe)
entries.notes: 闽南栏尾标[残]，按体例降为 low；但‘过先生/âr sin sē/bribe the escribano’三栏互证清晰，释义可从

entries.zh: 补搭；缝补、修补（西语 remediar：补救、修好；亦指把事情弥补周全）
entries.en: to patch, mend; to remedy, patch up (Spanish phrase sobornar por remediar el playa, reading of 'playa' doubtful)

entries.zh: 分班；分组排班、分派班组〔与西语词条对应关系不明，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to divide into classes, gangs or shifts; the link with the Spanish headword phrase is unclear
entries.notes: 西语同头短语（sobornar p̂ remediar el playa）与‘分班’义理不通，疑词条错位或西文误读（playa/playo 标[疑]），故存疑

entries.zh: 剩；剩余、剩下
entries.en: to be left over, remain; surplus

entries.zh: 残；残余、剩下（残存之物）
entries.en: leftover, remnant; what remains over

entries.zh: 残剩；残余剩下（余剩之物）
entries.en: leftovers, remains

entries.zh: 立不了；（屋里）立不下脚、站不住，没有空处（西语：屋里已无余地）
entries.en: no room left in the house; no place left to stand

entries.zh: 食不了；吃不完（饭食有余剩）〔闽南栏后段残损〕
entries.en: food left over; more food than can be eaten
entries.notes: 闽南栏尾段[残]（杂有西语 comida sobran），但 chiâh m̄ liāu／食不了／sobrar comida 主义互证清晰

entries.zh: 剩无几；剩下不多〔闽南栏尾三音节残损难辨〕
entries.en: little remains; only a little is left
entries.notes: ‘剩無幾’三字与 sīn bō xoā 互证清晰，尾三音节[残]且 T99 污损，主释义仍可从

entries.zh: 衰微；衰败微弱（所剩无几而式微）〔闽南首字涂改难辨〕
entries.en: to decline, dwindle, be reduced to little
entries.notes: 闽南栏首字母处涂改[残]且 T99；汉字‘衰微’与 sobrar poco 义理可通，但闽南证不全

entries.zh: 剩几〔涂改残损，释义存疑〕；汉字‘剩几’与西语 sobrar mucho（剩得多）相抵，原文疑有讹误
entries.en: sobrar mucho: much is left over; the Chinese 'sheng ji' is inconsistent with the Spanish and the text appears altered
entries.notes: 汉字与西语义相抵，且闽南栏涂改[残]，原词条本义无法定夺
